info.description: Public Formbrew form manifest and submission API.
info.title: Formbrew Public API

schema.description: UPLOAD_ALREADY_ATTACHED: the files were already submitted. details.submissionId and details.message are that submission's.

post.description: Declares up to 20 files for an active form's File fields and returns a short-lived upload slot for each: post the slot's fields and then the file, as multipart/form-data, to its URL. Then submit the form with each upload's ID in its field's value. Uploads that no submission attaches expire after three hours.

get.summary: Download a file from a webhook link
get.description: Opens a file's download link from a webhook. The link works for 24 hours after the submission was accepted, while the file is clean; it redirects to a five-minute link to the file.

schema.description: Redirects to a five-minute link to the file.
